title: Minimum input schema for MINING_5_Final.ipynb
description: The notebook uses these six fields only. Additional source columns are ignored and not loaded.

Dates.accepted_values: non-null values parseable by pandas as dates or timestamps

Category.use: descriptive summaries and sampling strata; excluded from clustering features

PdDistrict.use: encoded modeling feature and aggregated summaries

additional_columns: allowed in the source CSV but not loaded by the notebook
